method_note: Every entry was verified by fetching the live URL from this machine on 2026-08-19. Counts marked 'measured' come from a full crawl of the listed index pages; counts marked 'estimated' state the arithmetic used. robots.txt was fetched separately for every High-priority source.

sources.name: Austrotherm Srbija — Distributeri
sources.estimate_method: measured — parsed the single fetched page (265,570 bytes): 318 entries carry a 'T +38x ...' phone line; 289 are +381 (Serbia) and 29 are +382 (Montenegro). 270 distinct Serbian phone numbers across 224 distinct company names (a company with several branches repeats).

pagination.how: Entire alphabetical A-Z list is inlined in one static HTML document. One GET returns everything.

sources.robots_rule: User-agent: * — Disallow: /*?id=* ; /*&id=* ; /*?L=0* ; /*&L=0* ; /*?type=98* ; /*/Private/* ; /fileadmin/templates/html/* ; /*/Configuration/* ; /typo3temp/*. No rule matches /distributeri, so it is allowed.
sources.recommended_approach: Single cheerio fetch of /distributeri. Entries are flat text triplets: NAME line, 'Street, POSTAL City' line, 'T +381 (0)NN NNN NN NN' line. Split on the phone line and walk two lines back for name + address. Filter out +382 rows (Montenegro) — the 'Distributeri CRNA GORA' heading sits mid-alphabet and is NOT a reliable section boundary; use the phone country prefix instead.
sources.duplicate_risk: Medium — many of these companies also appear on mirandre.com and portal-srbija.com. Dedup on normalized phone will collapse them cleanly.
sources.notes: Highest yield-per-request source found in this task: ~289 phone-carrying store records for ONE HTTP request, and the segment fit is exact — these are the yards that already stock EPS. 60 of the 289 Serbian numbers are mobile (06x), the rest landline. At least two rows have a malformed phone field (e.g. 'T Kršumlija') and must be dropped at the zod boundary.

sources.name: PortalSrbija.com — Stovarišta (city index)
sources.estimate_method: measured — enumerated 112 'stovarista-<grad>' URLs from sitemap1..8.xml (65,931 total URLs), fetched all 112, and extracted phone lines: 425 per-page unique numbers, 361 globally unique (317 landline, 44 mobile). Only 3 of the 112 city pages were empty.

pagination.how: Sharded by city instead of paged. One page per city, all listings inline. 112 city pages = full national coverage.

sources.robots_rule: User-Agent: * / Allow: / / Disallow: /admin*/ / Disallow: /pretraga/ — /stovarista-* is not matched by any Disallow.
sources.recommended_approach: Get the 112 city URLs from https://www.portal-srbija.com/sitemap1.xml … sitemap8.xml by filtering <loc> on '/stovarista-'. Fetch each with cheerio. Every listing block renders as: company name, 'Grad,', address, then one or more phone lines separated by '|', then optional website, then a free-text description. No detail-page fetch is needed — the category page already carries name + city + address + phone + website.
sources.duplicate_risk: High against mirandre.com — the two sites share an identical robots.txt shape, the same city-slug scheme and visibly overlapping listings (Nikša Komerc, Termodom, Džavić and Domino appear on both). Treat them as one operator family and dedup aggressively on normalized phone.
sources.notes: Best national coverage of the pure-stovarište segment: 112 towns, not just Belgrade. Beograd 68 phones, Novi Sad 45, Niš 18. Landline-heavy (88%), which is normal for yards — the decision-maker still answers it.

sources.name: Mirandre.com — Stovarišta (city index + detail pages)
sources.estimate_method: measured — the Beograd page links 161 'stovarista/<grad>' city pages; fetched all 161 and collected detail-page slugs: 608 city→listing links resolving to 294 distinct store detail pages. Phone strings on the category pages: 554 across all cities (Beograd alone: 45 listings / 59 numbers), i.e. more than one number per listing.

pagination.how: One page per city, no paging. 161 city pages cover the country.

sources.robots_rule: User-Agent: * / Allow: / / Disallow: /admin*/ / Disallow: /pretraga/ / Disallow: /korisnici/ — /stovarista/* and the detail slugs are allowed.
sources.recommended_approach: Seed on https://www.mirandre.com/stovarista/beograd, harvest the 161 https://www.mirandre.com/stovarista/<grad> links, fetch each, then take detail slugs matching https://www.mirandre.com/<slug> (excluding /stovarista/, /blog, /gradjevinarstvo and any '/cene-cenovnik' suffix). Phones are already on the category page, so the 294 detail fetches are optional enrichment, not required for the phone.
sources.duplicate_risk: High against portal-srbija.com (same operator family, overlapping listings). Medium against Austrotherm.
sources.notes: Purely stovarište-focused — almost no classification noise, unlike general directories. 161 city slugs is the widest geographic spread of any source here. Several listings also expose a '/cene-cenovnik' price page, useful later for assortment signals but irrelevant to phone yield.

sources.name: NaVidiku.rs — Stovarišta i Građevinski materijal (category × city)
sources.estimate_method: measured — 24 'stovarista-<grad>' category URLs found in sitemap-categories-001.xml.gz / sitemap-subcategories-001.xml.gz; fetched all 24 and read the page's own 'Prikazano 1-N od M rezultata' counter: 132 listings total, 111 distinct tel: numbers (84%). A further 34 'gradjevinski-materijal-<grad>' and 4 'boje-fasade-i-lakovi-<grad>' subcategories exist and are not counted in the 132.

pagination.how: 'Prikazano 1-N od M rezultata' counter with /N page suffixes; at current volumes every stovarišta category fits on one page.

sources.robots_rule: User-agent: * / Disallow: /crm, /video/admin, /tv-uzivo/assets, /firme/assets, /gmap.php, /maintenance.php, /2k19, /2k20, /2k21, /mn, /fcache, /firme/ajax, /firme/noviajax — the rendered /firme/<category>-<city> pages are allowed; only the AJAX endpoints are off-limits.
sources.recommended_approach: Enumerate categories from https://www.navidiku.rs/sitemap/sitemap-categories-001.xml.gz and sitemap-subcategories-001.xml.gz (7,230 subcategory URLs), filter on 'stovarista-' and 'gradjevinski-materijal-'. Phones are NOT in the visible text — they sit in HTML-escaped tel: hrefs (e.g. tel:+381184562323 alongside a display label like '011/311-4324'). Parse href="tel:..." after HTML-unescaping; do not regex the rendered text. Never touch /firme/ajax — robots.txt forbids it.
sources.duplicate_risk: Medium — overlaps the two portal-srbija/mirandre sites on the big Belgrade yards, but carries small-town listings they miss.
sources.notes: Smaller than the other three but the cleanest structured markup (JSON-LD + tel: hrefs), so the adapter is the simplest to write and the least likely to break. Whole-site company base is 13,408 detail pages (sitemap-companies-001.xml.gz) across all industries.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API — Serbia building/hardware shops
sources.estimate_method: measured — ran the Overpass query below on 2026-08-19 (osm_base timestamp 2026-08-19T20:53:16Z). 608 elements returned (523 nodes, 81 ways, 1 relation on the count query). Field coverage computed locally from the full tag dump.

pagination.how: Single POST returns the whole result set.

sources.robots_rule: Overpass is a public API, not a crawled site. Usage is governed by the Overpass fair-use policy (throttle to a few queries per minute — this task was HTTP-throttled twice at higher rates) and by the OSM ODbL licence, which requires attribution and share-alike on derived databases.
sources.recommended_approach: One scheduled POST per refresh, cached to disk. Do NOT hammer it — 5 sequential queries in a row got throttled during this research; use one combined query with 'out tags center;' and split locally. Nodes and ways both matter (81 ways = yards mapped as polygons), so read 'center' for coordinates.
sources.duplicate_risk: Medium-Low — OSM names are informal ('Stovariste gradjevinskog materijala') and often lack a legal form, so name-based matching is unreliable. Dedup on phone first, then on lat/lon proximity + street.
sources.notes: Honest assessment of Serbian OSM coverage: usable but not good. Only 39% of the 608 elements carry any phone tag, and 81 have no name at all. 'trade=building_supplies' returned zero elements in Serbia, and 'shop=building_material' (singular) is a 3-element typo variant of the 23-element 'shop=building_materials' — neither is the mapping convention here. The bulk sits under shop=hardware (297 elements, 149 with phone), which mixes real gvožđare with locksmiths and tool shops, so classification noise is high. Its real value is not volume: it is the only source giving lat/lon, which makes it the best cross-check for deduping the directory sources geographically, and the shop=hardware slice is where multi-branch chains surface — every chain in the chains section below was discovered from repeated name/brand/operator tags in this dump.

sources.name: 011info.com — Građevinarstvo → Stovarišta / Građevinski materijal
sources.estimate_method: estimated — /stovarista paginates to exactly 2 pages (/stovarista/2 = HTTP 200, /stovarista/3 = HTTP 404) at ~10 listings/page ≈ 20; /gradjevinski-materijal likewise reaches at least page 2 ≈ 20+. Combined ≈ 40 Belgrade-area store records. The whole-site company base is far larger — 23 firme_N.xml sitemaps × 6,000 URLs ≈ 138,000 company pages — but that spans every industry, not stores.

pagination.how: /<category>/<n>, 1-indexed, 404 past the last page — walk until 404.

sources.robots_rule: User-agent: * / Allow: / / Sitemap: https://www.011info.com/sitemap.xml — no Disallow at all.
sources.recommended_approach: Only worth running for the three store categories: /stovarista, /gradjevinski-materijal and /izolacija-hidroizolacija-termoizolacija (all confirmed present in podoblasti.xml). The category page carries name + address + a long assortment description but truncates the phone ('Tel...'), so a detail-page fetch per listing is required for the number. Skip /<category>/blizu-mene — it is a geolocation duplicate of the same list.
sources.duplicate_risk: High — Belgrade-only, so it overlaps almost entirely with portal-srbija's Beograd page.
sources.notes: Belgrade-only by design (011 = Belgrade dialling code). Low incremental volume, but the assortment descriptions are unusually detailed — they literally list 'stiropor', 'mineralna vuna', 'građevinski lepak' — which is the best free signal available for scoring how relevant a yard is to an EPS facade panel. Worth scraping for the description field even though the phone yield is modest.

sources.name: Gradjevinarstvo.rs — baza firmi
sources.estimate_method: not estimated — the category/search endpoints that would let a crawler count are the exact paths robots.txt forbids (see rule), and /sitemap.xml returns an ASP.NET 'resource cannot be found' page. Detail pages are reachable by numeric id (2165 = Austrotherm, 1275 = Knauf Insulation), so the id space is walkable but its size was not measured.

pagination.how: Via /Pretraga/ and /Kategorije/GetFirme/ — both Disallowed. Only id-walking on /firme/<id>/<slug> is permitted.

sources.robots_rule: User-agent: * / Disallow: /admin/, /Kategorije/GetFirme/, /FirmaDetaljiURL/, /TekstDetaljiURL/, /Pretraga/, /Komentari/, /VestDetaljiURL/, /malioglasi/, /PrintTekst.aspx*, /firmadetalji.aspx* — /firme/<id>/<slug> is allowed; the listing and search endpoints are not.
sources.recommended_approach: Only viable as a slow enrichment pass: walk /firme/<id>/<slug> ids with a crawl delay and classify from the page body. Do not build a listing crawler — every listing endpoint is Disallowed. Verified: /firme/2165/austrotherm renders 3 landline numbers (014 293 635, 018 285 000, 014 291 310) in plain text.
sources.duplicate_risk: Medium — skews to manufacturers and large firms already covered by Austrotherm's own list.
sources.notes: Reachable and phone-bearing, but robots.txt deliberately blocks the enumeration paths, which caps this at id-walking. Rank it below the four High sources and only run it if their combined yield falls short.

sources.name: HaloOglasi.com — classifieds
sources.estimate_method: not estimated — every category path tried returned HTTP 403 to a non-browser client, including /sitemaps/sitemap.xml, so no listing could be counted.

pagination.how: unverified — blocked before a listing page could be read.

sources.robots_rule: User-agent: * / Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference / Allow: / — then a second 'User-agent: *' block with Disallow: /profil, /postavite-oglas, /upload, *?print, /prijava, /registracija. Named AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, meta-externalagent, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended) are each Disallow: /. An honestly-named lead crawler falls under the permissive 'User-agent: *' rule, and 'ai-train=no' is compatible with lead extraction, which is not model training.
sources.recommended_approach: Do not build this now. It is Cloudflare-fronted and 403s non-browser clients, so it would need Playwright plus a browser UA — exactly the cost the cheaper sources avoid. Revisit only if contractor-side yield (FUZZ-4) makes the Playwright budget worth spending.
sources.notes: robots.txt permits us; the WAF does not. Recorded so nobody re-litigates it. The 403 is a technical block, not a permission problem.

sources.name: Bekament — Prodajna mesta / Mix centri
sources.estimate_method: measured — fetched the page (873,341 bytes). Exactly one phone number appears in the HTML and it is Bekament's own head-office number (+381 34 677 75 00). Zero distributor records are present in the served markup.
sources.robots_rule: User-agent: * / Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference / Allow: / — but ClaudeBot, GPTBot, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended and meta-externalagent are each Disallow: /. An honestly-named lead crawler matches 'User-agent: *' and is allowed.
sources.recommended_approach: Not worth it as-is. The list is injected client-side by a 'Slider Container > Repeater' widget whose data never reaches the static HTML. It would require Playwright, or reverse-engineering the widget's data endpoint, for an unknown payoff. If a later task needs it, first check whether the Repeater fetches a JSON endpoint that can be called directly.
sources.duplicate_risk: Medium — Bekament is a domestic ETICS maker, so its mix centres are largely the same yards Austrotherm already lists with phones.
sources.notes: Painful negative result: Serbia's biggest domestic facade-system manufacturer publishes its sales network, but ships it as a JS repeater with no phone field visible. Austrotherm's plain-HTML list gives the same kind of data for free — use that instead.

sources.name: knauf-distributeri.com — Prodajna mesta Knauf Srbija asortimana
sources.estimate_method: measured — fetched the homepage (42,910 bytes): zero tel: links and zero phone-shaped strings in the served HTML; the payload is almost entirely WordPress block-library CSS.
sources.robots_rule: not checked — the source was disqualified on phone yield before it reached the robots stage.
sources.recommended_approach: Skip. Note also that https://www.knaufinsulation.rs/distributeri and https://tools.knaufinsulation.com/sr-RS/tools/distributeri both return HTTP 403 to non-browser clients, so the official Knauf channel is closed too.
sources.notes: Named promisingly and ranked well in search, but the served markup carries no contact data. Recorded so it is not re-tried.

sources.name: KupujemProdajem.com
sources.estimate_method: measured for the field that matters — fetched a građevinski-materijal search page (794,022 bytes): zero phone numbers in the HTML.
sources.robots_rule: User-agent: * — Disallow: /phone_* and Disallow: /ad_phone_image.php. The advertiser's phone number is served as a rendered IMAGE from a path robots.txt explicitly forbids. (ClaudeBot, GPTBot, CCBot, PerplexityBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot and others are additionally Disallow: /.)
sources.recommended_approach: Reject for phone acquisition. Getting the number would mean fetching a robots-forbidden path and OCR-ing an image whose only purpose is to stop exactly that. That is not a grey area — it is the site saying no.
sources.notes: The single most-cited Serbian classifieds site, and a hard no for this project. Its phone-as-image-behind-a-Disallow design is a deliberate anti-scraping measure; honouring it is both the compliance-correct and the cheap answer. Titles and cities are scrapable, but a lead with no phone is not a lead here.

sources.name: Daibau.rs — izvođači i firme
sources.estimate_method: not estimated — every category path guessed returned HTTP 404, and the phone-revealing endpoint is robots-blocked, so counting was pointless.
sources.robots_rule: User-Agent: * — Disallow: /autosecretary/getPhoneNumber/ (plus /iskanje/, /projektanti-izvajalci/, /references/showListCategoried/ and many *anfrage* / *posalji_narudzbu* order paths). The phone is fetched through /autosecretary/getPhoneNumber/, which is Disallowed.
sources.recommended_approach: Reject for phone acquisition, same reasoning as KupujemProdajem: the number sits behind an explicitly Disallowed AJAX endpoint. Company names and cities are scrapable and could seed a name+city match against other sources, but that is a weak dedup signal and not worth an adapter.
sources.notes: Primarily a contractor marketplace, so more relevant to FUZZ-4 than to stores — but it fails on the same phone-endpoint rule either way, which is worth knowing on both sides.

sources.name: APR — Agencija za privredne registre (pretraga privrednih subjekata)
sources.estimate_method: not estimated — the search host returns HTTP 403 to a non-browser client (and only a 1,401-byte shell on the unified search path), so no result set could be read.
sources.robots_rule: not reached — blocked at HTTP 403 before robots evaluation was meaningful.
sources.recommended_approach: Do not build a scraper. Two independent reasons: the public register does not publish a business telephone number at all (it carries legal name, matični broj, PIB, registered address and šifra delatnosti), and the search UI is a 403-guarded SPA. Its one genuine use is later, as an offline authority file for canonicalising company names and attaching a PIB to a lead already found elsewhere — not as a discovery source.
sources.notes: Explicitly checked because the issue asked for 'the company registry (APR-derived listings)'. Verdict: the registry itself is worthless for a phone-first pipeline. The APR-derived commercial directories (portal-srbija, navidiku, 011info) are where that same registry data becomes reachable WITH a phone attached — go there instead.

sources.name: Yell.rs — Yellow Pages Srbija
sources.estimate_method: not estimated — https://yell.rs/sitemap.xml (declared in robots.txt) returned no <loc> entries, and https://yell.rs/delatnost/gradjevinski-materijal/ answered HTTP 200 with a JPEG body rather than a listing, so category enumeration failed.

pagination.how: unverified — category URL scheme not established.

sources.robots_rule: User-agent: * / Allow: / / Crawl-Delay: 10 / Disallow: /wp-admin/ (Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php). The 10-second crawl delay is binding and makes any large walk slow.
sources.recommended_approach: Only if the High sources under-deliver. Profile pages do carry a phone (verified: /profil/woby-haus/ exposes tel:021 472 2212), so the data is there — but with no working sitemap and no confirmed category URL scheme, discovery would have to come from an external index, and the mandated 10s crawl delay caps throughput at roughly 360 pages/hour.
sources.duplicate_risk: High — a general yellow-pages index over the same businesses the four High sources already cover.
sources.notes: Phone present on detail pages, discovery path broken. Cost per lead is far worse than Austrotherm or portal-srbija for the same businesses.

sources.name: Stovarista.rs
sources.estimate_method: measured — fetched the Beograd page (90,938 bytes) and the site root (47,576 bytes): zero phone-shaped strings and zero tel: links in either.
sources.robots_rule: not checked — disqualified on phone yield first.
sources.recommended_approach: Skip.
sources.notes: The domain name is the best thing about it. Exactly the trap this registry exists to prevent: an on-topic-looking directory with no reachable phone numbers.

sources.estimate_method: measured — fetched the category page (47,567 bytes): zero phone-shaped strings in the served HTML.
sources.robots_rule: not checked — disqualified on phone yield first.
sources.recommended_approach: Skip unless a later spot-check shows phones on detail pages; the category page alone gives nothing.

sources.name: Izolacija.rs
sources.estimate_method: measured — fetched the root (252,800 bytes): zero phone-shaped strings; the guessed /prodavci path returned HTTP 404.
sources.robots_rule: not checked — disqualified on phone yield first.

sources.name: Google Places API
sources.estimate_method: not measured — not called. Project cost policy forbids calling a paid API without explicit approval in the issue, and no approval is present in FUZZ-5.

sources.name: Facebook / Instagram business pages
sources.estimate_method: not measured — not attempted.
sources.robots_rule: Meta's robots.txt broadly Disallows crawling for unapproved agents, and page content is gated behind a login wall for most queries.
sources.recommended_approach: Reject. Scraping behind a login is out of bounds under this project's compliance rules. Facebook/Instagram URLs found ON other sources (as a contact field) are fine to store — going to Meta to discover leads is not.
sources.notes: Recorded as an explicit boundary, not an oversight.

sources.name: Metalac Market
sources.estimate_method: 81 retail outlets in Serbia (11 in Belgrade) per the company's published description; the /store-locations page itself fetched at 1,060,956 bytes with only one phone number in the HTML, i.e. the locator is JS-rendered.
sources.robots_rule: not checked — out of segment scope.
sources.recommended_approach: Do not scrape. Out of scope.
sources.notes: Rejected on relevance, not on data quality. Metalac Market sells cookware, water heaters, sinks, white goods and consumer electronics — it is not a building-materials outlet and would never resell a facade panel. Recorded because it surfaces at the top of every 'maloprodajni lanac Srbija' search and will otherwise be re-investigated.

chains.note: Every chain below was discovered empirically, by counting repeated name/brand/operator values in the 608-element OpenStreetMap dump, then confirming the operator's own domain. 'osm_locations' is a measured floor, not a company claim — OSM under-maps Serbia, so the true store count is at or above this number. Chain locator pages proved LESS useful than the issue anticipated: of the 11 chains found, none publishes a plain-HTML store list with phone numbers on its own site, and the only chain store list with phones located anywhere was a third-party article.

entries.name: Woby Haus
entries.cities: Novi Sad (HQ), Beograd (4 + Zemun 2 + Batajnica), Niš (2), Čačak, Jagodina, Kragujevac, Kruševac, Šabac, Kraljevo, Smederevo, Subotica, Valjevo, Inđija
entries.segment_fit: Partial — hand and power tools, hardware and DIY rather than a building-materials yard. Classify as CONSTRUCTION_MATERIAL_STORE only after a per-store assortment check.
entries.notes: Largest chain in the OSM dump by a wide margin (48 mapped locations, tagged both 'Woby haus' and 'Woby Haus'). Its own site is an e-commerce storefront with no store locator — /prodajni-objekti and /maloprodajni-objekti both 404, and /kontakt lists only the order line 021 210 2100. The usable list is the third-party krov.rs article, which carries all 36 addresses WITH phone numbers (e.g. 'BEOGRAD, Batajnica — Majora Zorana Radosavljevića 319, 011/787-05-05').

entries.name: Doming / Domino građevinski centar
entries.notes: 14 OSM locations, second-largest chain found. doming.rs served 48,311 bytes with no phone in the HTML; the related https://www.dominosrbija.com/kontakt does expose 3 phone numbers. Highest-priority chain for a manual pass because the segment fit is exact.

entries.notes: 14 OSM locations, 13 of them tagged in Cyrillic ('Уради сам') — a concrete reminder that name-based dedup MUST handle Cyrillic/Latin transliteration, not just diacritic folding. Site returned 911,681 bytes with zero phones; /prodavnice and /maloprodajni-objekti both 404.

totals.dedup_reasoning: Raw sum of the phone-bearing sources: Austrotherm 289 + portal-srbija 361 + mirandre 294 + navidiku 132 + OSM-with-phone 240 + 011info ~40 + chain locations ~68 = 1,424. The four directory sources overlap heavily (portal-srbija and mirandre are the same operator family; Austrotherm's yards are largely the same businesses those directories list), so after dedup on normalized phone the realistic distinct count is 800-950. This is a projection from observed overlap, not a measured figure — the first pipeline run should replace it with a real number.
